description_en: Creates an asynchronous task to query the 5G capability of mobile devices
description_zh: 创建终端5G适配情况查询任务（异步）
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi create-rcs-mobile-capable-task --phone-numbers-file MTg400000000000000000000DIKMTg4NjgxMDAwMDM= --sign-name '阿里云5G消息' --template-code RCS_SMS_10000052 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRCSMobileCapableTask

parameters.help_en: The TXT file that contains the phone numbers to query. Commit the file using Base64 encoding of the TXT file. Only 11-digit phone numbers without area codes are supported. The file must not contain a header row. Each line contains one phone number. A single file supports up to 100,000 phone numbers
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的手机号txt文件。使用txt文件的base64编码提交，仅支持11位手机号，不带区号，文件无表头，每一行一个手机号，单文件最多支持10万个手机号
parameters.name: phone_numbers_file
